title: Run a small slice through ork run end to end
lead: S17 human check is still open: ork approve has never run on a live run. After S23, run a small slice with ork run, then approve it, and record every gap as a tracked fix. Goal: stop driving relays by hand (owner, 2026-10-20).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S17 human check is still open: ork approve has never run on a live run. After S23, run a small slice with ork run, then approve it, and record every gap as a tracked fix. Goal: stop driving relays by hand (owner, 2026-10-20).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: - Whatever the run exposes; tracked as follow-up slices.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- A small slice runs through ork run, ork status shows its progress, ork approve lands it.
- Each gap found is filed as a slice.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Run S78 (recoverRuns map writes under lock: size S, engine-only, no goldens) through ork itself. The owner rebuilds with `build-in-home-dir.sh` (~/bin/ork) and restarts the daemon with `~/bin/ork daemon restart`, then opens ork with `run-in-home-dir.sh`. In Waves, tick only S78 (space; well specified yes, split no), check the lineup (implementer codex gpt-6.1-sol medium from matrix row r9; reviewer and gate opus medium), and launch (l). The owner follows and answers the run in ork; the outer agent session only watches (ork status, the ledger) and changes nothing in the run. Approve in ork. Landing in ork is S119; until then the outer session lands. File every gap as a slice with --discovered-from S31, and answer the open S17 human check (ork approve on a live run).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: S78 reaches committed through ork with gate PASS; the relay-run ledger shows every role step; each gap is a filed slice; the S17 human check is answered. go test -race ./...; slicer check; adj lint.
